page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top centre. Below it a heading, then a woodcut engraving of a circle in a landscape. Below the engraving, a four-line Latin verse in italic, with a large initial. Handwritten English translation in ink below the verse, not printed and not transcribed.

l.i: Principium in tereti quaeris quicunq; figura,
Principium inuenies hic vbi finis erit.
Sic Christum vero quisquis reuereris amore, Quæ vitam hora tibi finiet, incipiet.

page.notes: The engraving shows a circle within a landscape with a tree, rocks and a town; described here, not transcribed. The handwritten English translation beneath the verse is manuscript ink, not printed text, and is left out. No page number, catchword or signature is printed. The verse reading "quicunq;" and "Quæ" is taken from the scan; the first word of line 3 is clear, but the spelling of "Quæ" in line 4 is slightly uncertain.
